lean.name: Triple.of_le_wp
lean.plain: Pointwise comparison with the weakest precondition
lean.annotation: To reset one qubit, measure it in the computational basis and apply $X$ on outcome one. Pulling the target projector $|0\rangle\langle0|$ back through the conditional gives the outcome-zero and outcome-one projectors, respectively. The measurement rule adds them to the identity, so `Triple.of_le_wp` applies with precondition $\top$.

lean.name: expect_wp
lean.plain: Equal expectations before and after execution
lean.annotation: For an outcome $o$, the postcondition uses $\Psi(\sigma[x\mapsto o])$ on $M_o\Delta(\sigma)M_o^\dagger$. Cyclicity of trace puts the same expectation on the input state by moving the measurement operators to the observable. The measurement rule in Fig. S3 sums these observables over $o$.

lean.name: expect_wp
lean.plain: Equal expectations before and after execution
lean.annotation: By `expect_wp`, a valid precondition must have expectation at most that of `wp c Ψ` on every input. Test this inequality on a pure state at a single store. As the vector varies, it gives the Löwner inequality at that store, so the weakest precondition is the largest valid assertion in that order.
